Yes
The division of red and green into separate contexts with pinned models provides unambiguous boundaries and prevents specification leakage. Grounding test design in explicit mutant-killing rows and differential checks gives backend implementation concrete criteria to satisfy without gaming or guesswork. Using measured slice evidence instead of flaky wall-clock assertions ensures tests remain fast, deterministic, and workable under standard development constraints.
